resolved_source_issues.issue: The inherited chapter compressed the course reset and omitted most of the closing physical examples.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The revision follows all 85 substantive beats from the negative-energy detour through photon diffraction.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Five inherited frames covered only a small part of the uncertainty proof and dynamics transition.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Fifteen full-resolution frames now cover the complete board sequence, both Ehrenfest derivations, and the classical-limit counterexamples.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The board proof used a strict sign and a real-wave-function simplification.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The sharp non-strict inequality is stated, the local simplification is explicit, and the complex-state commutator extension is separated from the board proof.

resolved_source_issues.issue: The historical Dirac-sea account could be mistaken for a modern literal vacuum description.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The historical role, fermion-boson distinction, one-dimensional neutrino analogy, and modern qualification are all explicit.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Time-energy and angle-angular momentum could be overgeneralized.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: Both are kept as carefully bounded Fourier-conjugate analogies with operator-domain and periodicity caveats.

resolved_source_issues.issue: Exact expectation-value equations could be confused with a proof of universal classical trajectories.
resolved_source_issues.resolution: The mean-force distinction, two-bump counterexample, localization condition, force expansion, mass scaling, and scattering examples are retained.
